cohort: Pregnant women and their newborns whose anthropometric and blood data were collected at birth.
finding: Maternal iron deficiency anemia (mild to moderate) can affect the blood profile and iron concentrations in umbilical cord blood of newborns, but without interfering with the child's anthropometric parameters.
birth_weight: Mean 3375.9g (for newborns of anemic mothers) and 3300.2g (for newborns of non-anemic mothers).
